page: Intro card (drawn by the capture): the BxAgents logo, the homepage line and Powered by BoxLang, music only

text: Your agent just got a workplace. A chat that streams. A memory that is yours. Routines, a vault, and an admin room. All built from one folder.
caption: One folder. A whole workplace.
page: login.html: type ada and demo-pass, sign in, land in Chat, a quick flick to Conversations and back

text: Ask a question and the answer streams in as it is written. When the agent reaches for a tool, you see a card for it. And when an action needs your say so, it stops and asks. You approve, and it carries on.
caption: Streaming chat, tool cards, approvals
page: Chat: ask 'Are you open right now?' (tool card opens); ask 'Send me a digest every weekday morning' (approval card), click Approve

text: Need a specialist? Pick a sub-agent in the header and talk to it directly. The researcher looks things up. The writer drafts replies. Each one keeps its own conversations.
caption: Talk to a sub-agent directly
page: Chat header: Talk to picker, choose researcher, ask 'Find sources for our shipping times', then switch to writer

text: Every conversation is kept. Search by title. Filter by agent or source. Page through them, and act on many at once.
caption: Conversations: search, filter, bulk actions
page: Conversations: type 'order' in search, clear it, click the researcher agent chip, clear the filter, tick three rows

text: Routines are agent work on a schedule. Ask once, and it runs every weekday morning and leaves a report each time. Members see their own. Admins see everyone's.
caption: Routines and their reports
page: Routines: open the Reports of build-check, close, switch the owner picker to a person

text: The registry shows what the agent can use. Tools, grouped by what they do. Skills you can open and read. And the folders it may touch.
caption: Registry: tools, skills, volumes
page: Registry: scroll Tools, open Skills and Read refund-policy, close, show Volumes

text: Memory comes in layers. Notes about you, which are yours alone. Notes the agent shares across its team. And the memory of each conversation, which you can clear any time.
caption: Memory: yours, shared, per conversation
page: Memory: add a note about you, scroll to the agent's notes and the conversation memory with its Clear buttons

text: Secrets go in the vault. The value is sealed and never shown again, and each one says what it is for and which hosts may see it.
caption: Vault: sealed secrets
page: Vault: hover CARRIER_API_KEY, switch to The agent's tab, scroll to the add form

text: Admins see the agent as it really is. The composition draws itself live: what reaches it, its sub-agents, its tools, and where it reaches out. Browse its files, and watch its usage.
caption: Agent: live composition, files, usage
page: Agent: Composition, scroll, Files and Read Agent.yaml, Usage

text: Gateways put the agent on Telegram, Slack and more. Each one shows its state and its chats, and a click reconnects it.
caption: Gateways and reconnect
page: Gateways: click Reconnect on a gateway

text: Logs by area: the agent, the routines, the heartbeat. Search them, filter by level, and let them refresh live. Secrets are never written.
caption: Logs by area
page: Logs: open Routines, search, tick Refresh every 5 s

text: Access is simple. Issue a named token, and it is shown once. See who can sign in, and choose who is an admin.
caption: Access: tokens and people
page: Access: make a token (secret shown once), People tab, hover Make an admin

text: Data and backups. See where everything lives and how big it is. Make a backup in one click, and restore one just as easily.
caption: Data and backups
page: Data and backups: click Make a backup

text: And it is yours to shape. Light or dark. Your accent colour. Text size, and how dense the page feels. The page remembers your choice.
caption: Light, dark, accent, size, density
page: Settings: Appearance, click Dark, pick an accent, Large then Medium text

text: On a phone the menu becomes a drawer. Targets are big, focus is always visible, and the whole page works from the keyboard.
caption: Phone layout and accessibility
page: A 390 px phone frame (served by the capture): the page, open the menu drawer, close it

text: Everything you just saw is also in the terminal, and in the API. The same notes, routines and conversations, from a bxAgents command or a plain HTTP call.
caption: Also in the terminal and the API
page: A terminal card (served by the capture): real output of bxAgents notes, routines and a curl to the API

text: BxAgents. One folder, one command, a whole agent workplace. Run bxAgents new, and read the docs on the project page. Your agent is waiting.
caption: bxAgents new
page: Closing card (drawn by the capture): the logo, bxagents.ai, bxAgents new, the repository address and Powered by BoxLang
